title: Reittiere, zaehmbare Drachen, Roboter-Fahrzeuge
goal: Dragon, Spyro, Cephadrome, Leon, WaterDragon, Stinky, GammaMetroid, RubberDucky and the two ridable robots with kit and wrench (docs/catalog/README.md section 4.10). Read the hand-off notes docs/port/W01.md to W08.md, FIX1.md, W12.md and W13.md first. W12/W13 already ran: spawners, natural spawn entries, chest items and eggs that name W09 entities by registry id (baby_dragon, cephadrome, dragon, leonopteryx, rubber_ducky, spider_driver, stinky, water_dragon, wtf, antrobotkit, spiderrobotkit ...) start working automatically once the ids exist - grep for TODO W09 in all of src/ and wire every remaining back-edge. DECISIONS R22-R24 apply (tags as 1.21.1 ships them, no owner death message for tame animals, chunk-generation spawns per R23). Apply DECISIONS R20 (NoStepTrigger where the original canTriggerWalking returns false; Mth.floor for coordinate casts) and the W04 XP lesson (1.7.10 EntityAnimal.getExperiencePoints returns 1 + rand.nextInt(3) regardless of experienceValue - check each entity's base class before porting XP). ENTITY PORTER CONTRACT as in docs/port/waves/w06.json goal (entity class with original name, attributes, SynchedEntityData, NBT, goals, customServerAiStep physics, Java drops R10, sounds, spawn placement; EntityType + attributes + renderer + layer + spawn egg via registry_entries; <Name>Model baking <Name>Geometry with setupAnim from the original; renderer scale() and texture variants). RIDING: tickRidden/getRiddenInput with the W01 per-player fly-up key state (R15); the original flight phase does not call super.onLivingUpdate - reproduce that order; verify whether Player.zza/xxa are set server-side (catalogue 6.3). Ownership takeover and attackEntityFrom-returns-false bugs 1:1 (R18). Back-edges: grep 'TODO W09'.
